inherited_work.task1_partial: Not present in this isolated Task 2 worktree; preserved by making no changes outside the declared ownership.
inherited_work.source_base: Task 2 source and tests were clean/absent at the approved Task0 base; no partial implementation was inherited.

implementation.domain: domain_paths derives Linux paths from pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()) or macOS paths from the account home, validates equal real/effective uid, local supported filesystem, existing canonical ownership/modes and private metadata without creating/chmodding/pruning anything. Explicit fixture domains require an existing private root and strict bounded fixture-domain.toml with matching uid/device/inode and a 32-hex fixture id.
implementation.process: process_identity observes only psutil birth time, real/effective uid and os.getpgid, rejects inaccessible/split/reused observations, and never reads argv or environment.
implementation.groups: probe_group uses killpg(pgid, 0) only; ESRCH is the sole absent result, while permission/other errors remain indeterminate.
implementation.boot: boot_identity reads Linux kernel boot_id or formats a macOS psutil boot-time observation and raises a typed state-unavailable error when the observation cannot be obtained.

abuse_cases: A HOME/XDG/PTEST_* change must not relocate the normal coordination domain.
Absent canonical parents must not be created by read-only resolution; existing legacy siblings must not be changed, pruned or interpreted.
Foreign owners, writable parents, symlink components, hardlinked metadata, unsupported/network filesystems and stale fixture identity must not authorize a domain.
Inaccessible or PID-reused observations must not authorize process ownership; split real/effective uid observations are rejected.
Group probing must never signal a process group; permission/unknown observations must not be treated as absent.
Boot identity failure must not be converted into a reusable/valid identity.
security.negative_red_green: The intended focused behavioral RED was blocked by the absent module (exit 2), accurately recorded as collection failure; all negative assertions turned GREEN in the 43-test scoped run. Test no-op sensitivity is nonvacuous: changing root derivation fails the environment/path assertions, removing marker checks fails strict/stale cases, and changing signal 0 fails the exact call assertion.
